purpose: Make the public MTG liquidation surface read canonical live commerce state and fail closed without inventing inventory.
changes: MTG surface reads /api/products with no-store caching.
Only silo=mtg, status=published, inventory>0 products are rendered from the product catalog.
If no published MTG products are returned, the surface falls back to /api/offers and renders only VERIFIED_AVAILABLE MTG offers.
Product checkout uses /api/checkout/create; offer fallback checkout uses /api/offer-checkout/create.
No inventory, price, or payment proof is fabricated by the public page.
payment_truth: No payment is claimed until a verified Stripe webhook records a paid transaction.
verification_target: GitHub Actions deploy workflow must compile, deploy, and prove EDH_0001 at NZD 400 with checkout_available=true.
